Introduction to Logic_x000D_ This course tries to teach students the general concept of logic, the general image of logic development so far, some of the most basic logic techniques and techniques, and the thoughts and spirit behind logic techniques. The specific content includes: Lecture 1: Logic is the science of reasoning and argumentation, giving an overview of the overall image of logic; Lecture 2: Propositional logic, studying the logical properties of compound propositions determined by connectives and the reasoning between compound propositions relationship; the third lecture: lexical logic, which studies the logical properties of categorical propositions (property propositions) and their inferential relations among each other; the fourth lecture: predicate logic, which studies the logical properties of quantitative propositions and their inferential relations among them . Propositional logic, lexical logic, and predicate logic are the focus of this course. In addition, this course will also teach the basic content of inductive logic.
